notes.title: Patch 0.85 - The Paloma Lakes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In occasion for the Steam Shoot 'em Up fest, we have decided to release a small content patch for Bullet Casters. While this update focuses mostly on new stages, we plan to bring many balancing and QoL improvements in the future updates based on the feedback on our Discord Channel and the Steam Discussion page. 

[b]UPDATES[/b]

- Introduced a new area: Paloma Lakes
- Introduced 5 new stages in the Paloma Lakes area
- Introduced a new boss fight.
- Introduced new battle themes for the Favill and Torden boss fights.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778614/fe4015f489d2c6436d1c317fe50967532131426a.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy these new challenges.

As a reminder, the game is currently on 25% sale!
If you like Bullet Casters, consider recommending it to your friends ;D

[url=https://discord.com/invite/qGUMBduvWy]Join the Bullet Casters' Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Patch 0.83 & OTK Games Expo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Bullet Casters has been selected to be featured in the OTK Games Expo, and to celebrate this event we are releasing a small patch with some new content and fixes. 

The OTK Games Expo is an event featuring many cool upcoming indie games that will be hosted on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/asmongold]Asmongold's Twitch channel[/url] today, June 10th. 

[b]UPDATES[/b]

Content:

- Introduced a new boss fight: [b]Guforobo [FEROX][/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778614/50b6866dcee265463f664479d6dff8b4564ef3fb.png[/img]

Balancing: 

- Ella's (boss) 2nd and 4th phase have been slightly nerfed. 
- The magic circles that fire downwards in Ella's (boss) have been changed to be more distinguishable from the aimed ones. 
- Buffed the Ocho attack option: its fire-rate now increases the further the option is from the player.

Fixes:

- Fixed an issue with the attack options sometimes not firing when the attack button is pressed when the level starts. 
- Xbox buttons are now displayed in the game UI when connecting a gamepad. Note that because of an issue that happens only when running the game on Steam if the controller is already connected when starting the game the buttons displayed will still be the PC ones. We are going to fix this issue with an upcoming minor patch. 
- Made Favill's (playable character) bullets less transparent. 

That is all for this update, take care!

notes.content:

notes.title: Bullet Casters Early Access is out now!! What's next?
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all I want to thank everyone who purchased the Early Access of Bullet Casters, your support means a lot to us <3

If you have played the game, please [b]consider leaving a honest review[/b]. We want to read your thoughts on it, so we can better shape the development of future content. Furthermore, reviews (and confirming tags) are really important to get visibility on Steam!

[b]DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP[/b]

In the near future we will keep updating the game with fixes, balancing and some other features suggested by the community. The next big step will be patch 0.9 which will add a whole new area, the oriental region of [b]Paloma[/b], with many new stages, enemies and bossfights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778614/bf92f04b78ccae47ae80ce14933048d05ddb19a9.png[/img]

[b]SOCIALS[/b]

Follow us on Twitter for the latest updates, and consider joining our Discord if you want to ask us something directly or talk about the game with other players!

If you have beaten either Arcanum [FEROX] or Stigma [FEROX], the ultimate challenges in the Early Access, you will also be assigned an honorary role on the server!

https://discord.com/invite/qGUMBduvWy


last but not least, check out the first music upload from the Bullet Casters soundtrack by our friend Dominic Ninmark!

https://youtu.be/aaPuYvlgTpw

Take care!

notes.title: Big Updates and ESA Winter demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It has been a while since our last devlog on Steam, during this time we have been working a lot on improving Bullet Casters and we can't wait to show you more. 

[b]GAME UPDATES[/b]

- the visuals have been deeply reworked: old assets have been updated to make the colors more coherent, new animations have been added to characters, bullets and enemies and the UI has been completely redrawn. 

- While the multiplayer mode will still be present, lately we moved the focus on the single player mode. It will now feature a story that you can go through as each of the 4 playable characters and more than 70 stages packed with many different monsters and boss-fights. 

- The soundtrack of the game has been completely remade by Dominic Ninmark (Gravity Circuit, Blazing Chrome, Mighty Goose, Rival Megagun and more).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778614/732b6a0ebfd134a28642e886732220ab7e62e8df.png[/img]

[b]ESA WINTER 2023[/b]

This weekend, 17th and 18th February, Bullet Casters will be present at ESA winter 2023 in Malmö (Sweden) with an exclusive demo! 
If you participate in the event, come say hi! Our station will be located in the practice room.
In case you are not familiar with the event, ESA is a speedrunning marathon livestreamed on Twitch that raises money for charity! [url=https://esamarathon.com/ettevent/esa-winter-2023/]ESA website[/url] for more info.

notes.title: New Demo available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Coconzilla here.
I am glad to announce that today an updated version of the Bullet Casters Demo is available!

[b]DEMO UPDATES[/b]

CHARACTER SELECTION IN CHALLENGE MODE

Originally we planned to develop the challenges of Bullet Casters to be played with a specific character, since for some of the levels you would really have to make full use of a certain Bullet Caster's unique ability.
Though thanks to the players' feedback we realized that most challenges would actually be fun and balanced with every fighter, Despite their extremely different shooting styles.

By pressing the Focus Button in the Challenge Mode menu it's now possible to switch between the 4 characters (except for the "Tutorial" challenge) here is a short overview of each of them:

[b]Ella[/b]
Balanced character with a shooting style that requires good precision but has very high single-target damage output. Her special ability changes whether you are pressing the Focus button or not.

[b]Favill[/b]
Beginner-friendly character that can easily deal with multiple enemies at the same time and doesn't require precise positioning. His damage against single targets is not as high as that of the other Bullet Casters. His special ability creates a small sun that deals high damage over time in an area, very useful to get past the opponents' defenses. 

[b]Hana[/b]
Technical character with high damage potential against both single and multiple targets. Her base attack can either shoot energy blades or be charged up to make Hana dash and slash all the enemies in her path. Her special ability allows her to place a portal that she can teleport to, which can be useful for escaping dangerous situations but also to reach enemies faster.

[b]Torden[/b]
Extravagant character that shoots electric bullets from the two drums spinning around him. You can press the Focus Button to stop the drums rotation, allowing you to hit enemies from any point of the battle-field. His special, not usable in Focus Mode, can be activated by pressing the Special Attack Button when his two drums are overlapping, and it generates a powerful thunder that penetrates the monsters' defenses. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778614/42cb0fb129d9b613ab632fa5cb22927df8c98e76.png[/img]

VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS

these are some visual improvements we added since the last demo:

- Made custom sprites for each character's name.
- Increased feedback when enemies get hit.
- Improved explosion when enemies are defeated.
- Added animation when mana is picked in Duel Mode. 
- Made Favill's bullets less distracting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778614/a57967e853879d83f8b53e13aaa93d2da19df052.png[/img]

As for the last demo, we would love to hear your feedback about the demo! 
You can use the "Send Feedback" and "Report Bug" in the game's main menu to write to us, and if you want to talk directly to the devs you can join our Discord server with this link:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/qGUMBduvWy]Bullet Casters official Discord server[/url]

That's all from me, I hope you have fun trying the demo!

Take care!

notes.title: Development Update - New Monsters, Challenges and Features
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
In this brief update we just want to update you about Bullet Casters' development. 
In the past weeks we have been working on new content for the game, as well as improving some of the existing features. 

[b]New content[/b]

- 5 new monsters, including Onibi, Firework Mage and Missile Golem.
- 4 new challenges.
- A new arena: Grayhurst Castle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778614/a57967e853879d83f8b53e13aaa93d2da19df052.png[/img]

[b]New and updated features[/b]

- Started working on the localization system.
- In Challenge Mode the player can now see his best completion time for each challenge.
- In Duel Mode, the monster selection menu has been reworked to convey info about each unity in a more immediate and efficient way through icons that represent their most important traits.

Furthermore, we are currently working on features for the Challenge Mode to make it more accessible and allowing for more different approaches to the levels. 

Check out some of the new content in this short video dev-log.

[previewyoutube=IwsKW7Ch83Y;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't already, consider subscribing to the Bullet Casters' Youtube Channel, we are going to post more previews of monsters and challenges soon!

That is all for this devlog, take care!

notes.title: Next Fest feedback and upcoming changes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
A few weeks have passed since the release of the Bullet Casters' Demo, and in this period we received a lot of helpful feedback and suggestions to improve the game.
In this devlog I want to share with you what feature we are going to change or add based on your input!

[b]Challenge Mode[/b]

Our goal is to make Challenge Mode overall more accessible, while keeping the raw challenge there for those who desire it. 
- The difficulty curve will be smoothed. 
- Time limits will be made generally less strict.
- We will add an "Assist Mode" to make it easier for player who are new to the genre to experience the game. 

[b]General[/b]

- The different characters of Bullet Casters play in significantly different ways, especially when it comes to special attacks. We want to make it easier to understand how they work without necessarily having to read their description.
- Visual feedback when hitting enemies will be increased.
- Visual and Audio feedback when collecting Mana (in Duel Mode) will be increased.

[b]QoL[/b]

- Favill's bullets speed and visuals will be adjusted to improve visual clarity.
- The time limits to get an extra star in the challenges will be made more clear and visible during the challenge itself. 
- The default option at the end of a challenge will be changed from "Retry" to "Continue".

[b]Hotfixes[/b]

These changes are already available after the last update

- New waves of enemies no longer spawn automatically if the player takes too long to complete the previous ones.
- The overall difficulty of the challenge "Ancient Guardians" has been slightly decreased.
- The duration of the endurance challenge "Maze of Darkness" has been reduced drastically, while the amount of bullets shot by enemies increased.
- Increased the size of Pick Ups in the Challenge Mode boss fights.

---------------------------------------------------------------

These are some of the points we are going to tackle first in the near future, but of course we have much more in store and there are a lot of intriguing suggestions we are currently evaluating. 
I remind you that if you want to send us your thoughts about the game or report a bug you can do so either from directly inside the game (using the "send feedback" button) or by joining the Bullet Casters Discord.

That is all for this devlog, take care!
